bibl.title: A Short Note on the Epitaph of Ama Helenê Ioudaia.
bibl.seg: Pieter van der Horst, A Short Note on the Epitaph of Ama Helenê Ioudaia.
bibl.note: Proposes a new interpretation of the epitaph of Ama Helenê Ioudaia, an inscription recently published by Lincoln H. Blumell [A New Jewish Epitaph Commemorating Care for Orphans, JSJ 47 (2016) pp. 310-329, figg.] on the basis of a different reading of some of the Greek words in this inscription.
